title: Time Jump — 09:15, Extended Advisory

fields.narration: Time jump: It is now 09:15 on Saturday, March 14, 2026. Four outpatients have been placed at the partner unit for today; five wait for tomorrow. Two inpatients have been transferred. The tank is at 35,800 gallons and use is steady at 1,150 gallons an hour. The city says the advisory will not lift before Sunday evening.
worldState: Water use remains at 1,150 gallons per hour.
The Do Not Drink advisory will not be lifted before Sunday evening.
Four outpatients have been scheduled for treatment at the partner unit today.
Five outpatients are scheduled for tomorrow.
Two inpatients have been transferred to alternate facilities.
The hospital is now in extended operational planning mode for a sustained advisory.
fields.facilitatorNote: This time jump advances the timeline to 09:15. The water conservation plan is in effect, and the hospital must now plan for an extended advisory. The team must assess long-term water allocation, prioritize patient care, and prepare for potential secondary impacts such as staff fatigue, infection risk, and public communication pressure.
